theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (x : Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + 1) N → IsOrientation (n + 1) N ξN → x ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), 0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < δ₂ ∧ closedBall x (δ₁ + δ₂) ⊆ U ∧ u 0 = 0 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u (ball 0 δ₁) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, (∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ u v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖u v‖ < δ₂ / 2 ∧ x + ι v + u v ∈ N ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), ξN (x + ι v + u v) α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (ι (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) ∧ ∀ (v : Euclid (n + 1)) (h : Euclid P), ‖v‖ < δ₁ → ‖h‖ < δ₂ → (∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) h = 0) → x + ι v + h ∈ N → h = u v
